decisions_for_owner: SCOPE OF ADOPTION. Options: (a) canvas for crew, org admin and super admin; (b) crew canvas only, consoles keep the current Sept-2026 'Instrument' ConsoleShell restyled to the new tokens; (c) crew now, consoles later after crew feedback. Recommendation: (c). Customisation pays off for crew, who return daily. The consoles are form- and table-heavy (Invite, Coaching form, New version, rules editors), and putting forms inside selectable, draggable widgets fights focus and selection.

HOW MUCH CUSTOMISATION, AND WHEN. Options: (a) full drag/resize/pin/arrange/lock at launch; (b) a fixed curated layout plus Hide/Add/Reset and an S/M/L/XL picker, with drag later; (c) no customisation, the canvas only as a visual style. Recommendation: (b), with keyboard 'Move' added before pointer drag (WCAG 2.5.7). Drop 'Pin' and 'Arrange' until drag exists, because they mean nothing on a fixed layout.

LAYOUT STORAGE MODEL. Options: (a) one desktop 12-column layout with 6/1 columns derived by reading order; (b) separate stored layouts per breakpoint; (c) one desktop layout plus a separate phone order. Recommendation: (c). Use one table public.user_canvas_layouts(user_id, surface, page) with a validated jsonb {desktop placements, phone order, size, hidden, pinned, snoozed_until}, owner-only RLS, explicit grants and layout_version. Delete the other four names from the specs.

HOW FULL DATA IS PRESENTED (the user's core question). Options: (a) separate document pages per domain, keeping the main bar, dropping the left bar and adding a back link; (b) a drawer over the canvas (Next 16 intercepting/parallel routes) that keeps the URL; (c) expanding the widget to XL in place. Recommendation: (a) for History, Sharing, Report, Rewards, Settings, the session detail and the briefing form. Use drawers only for short reads (Rules, Privacy, partner picker, context form). Design a 'detail page' template before building any of them.

MAIN-BAR BUTTON BEHAVIOUR. Options: (a) 'History' / 'Sharing' / 'Report' / 'Rewards' select their widget, as the board does; (b) they always navigate to the full page; (c) select if the widget is visible, else navigate. Recommendation: (b). The guide itself describes them as full destinations ('Every routine you generated…'), they must work from every /app/* page and when a widget is hidden, and selection already has its own trigger (the title bar). 'Start routine' opens the briefing form.

PHONE PATTERN. Options: (a) the desktop board's ≤720 CSS (top strip left bar); (b) the phone board (header row, floating bottom sheet, 5-item bar with 'More'). Recommendation: (b) below 720px. Contents of 'More': 'My report' with status, 'Add widget', 'Hidden widgets', 'Search', 'Guide', 'Notifications & privacy', 'Appearance', the role-gated switch links, and 'Sign out'. Keep the avatar a button that opens the account menu. Phone customisation is hide plus 'Move up' / 'Move down' only: no drag, no resize.

PHONE SHEET WITH MORE THAN 5 TOOLS. Options: (a) primary + 3 tools + a 'More' cell holding the rest including Pin/Hide; (b) wrap to a second row; (c) scroll horizontally. Recommendation: (a), but keep 'Hide' in the overflow and never hide the primary. Raise 'Deselect' to a 44px hit area.

TABLET AND MAIN-BAR OVERFLOW (720–1180). Options: wrap (the board), an overflow 'More', or icon-only. Recommendation: collapse 'Add', 'Layout', 'Search', 'Theme', 'Guide' into 'More' below 1180. Make the left bar sticky, and remap .c2/.c6/.c8 at every breakpoint.

BRAND. Options: (a) adopt 'S3' everywhere (logo, login, favicon, metadata); (b) keep 'Cognitive Copilot' and use S3 only as a mark; (c) keep the current brand. Recommendation: owner call. Build a BrandMark component from 'Claude outputs/s3-logo.svg' with a currentColor 'S' so dark mode works. Change login, favicon and the title template in the same release, so the brand is never half-switched.

PALETTE SCOPE. Options: (a) replace the global tokens (the concept is mostly a hue shift 240/250 → 275 at the same lightness, with an identical ok token) for /app, /admin and /super; (b) scope the new tokens to the crew canvas. Recommendation: (a). Add a --brand red that is distinct from --bad, and keep the existing amber --warn for pending and attention, which matches the guide's 'orange dot'. Ship dark values at the same time: the app already has a working dark theme, and the concept has none.

PRIMARY, ALERT AND DANGER COLOURS. Options: (a) red for CTAs, alerts and danger, as drawn; (b) red = the single primary CTA per view, amber = pending/attention, outline-red = destructive, green = ok. Recommendation: (b). Use red 'Continue to briefing' everywhere (fixing the navy one on the sizes board), and add text alternatives for every status dot.

TIER NAMES. Options: (a) keep Bronze/Silver/Gold/Platinum everywhere and drop 'Ready → Proficient'; (b) rename all four labels to a readiness ladder (four names needed; the boards imply Silver = Ready, Gold = Proficient) by migrating readiness_tiers.label and the literals in src/app/admin/page.tsx and src/app/super/actions.ts; (c) different names per surface. Recommendation: (a), unless product and legal approve readiness wording, which in aviation reads as an operational proficiency rating. Never (c). Render labels only from readiness_tiers via tierShort().

SESSION MODE LABEL. Options: 'Blind synergy' / 'Synergy' / both by size. Recommendation: 'Blind synergy' everywhere (current UI, settings 'Level 1 · Blind synergy', desktop board). At S, use a dot with the accessible name 'Blind synergy'. Show coaching sessions as 'Coaching', never as synergy.

COACHING ON THE CREW CANVAS. Options: (a) remove the 'Coaching' chip and fix guide step 2 copy; (b) show it to org admins as a link to /admin/coaching; (c) make coaching a crew routine (needs schema, consent and prompt changes). Recommendation: (a) + (b). Exclude coaching rows from the crew Recent list.

PARTNER CHOICE AND WHAT A PARTNER ROW SHOWS. Options for choice: auto-pick (today) vs an explicit 'Partner' picker. Options for the subtitle: rank (operational_category, which crew_directory() deliberately hides) vs team (already exposed). Recommendation: an explicit picker, with Solo plus usable partners and disabled rows with a reason, and team rather than rank unless privacy signs off on widening the directory. Show per-routine validity computed from valid_until.

SHARING SIGNAL SEMANTICS. Options: the dot means incoming only, outgoing only, or both. Recommendation: the dot and header meta mean 'N to review' (incoming), and the widget gets inline 'Approve · +15' / 'Decline'. Outgoing requests appear only as 'Pending' pills. Fix the guide copy ('orange dot' and its meaning) to match.

CONSENT LIFECYCLE CHANGES (security-critical). Options: (a) build 'Revoke' and 'Cancel' (new statuses, rewritten private.consent_guard, new RLS policies); (b) also build a requested duration; (c) remove 'Revoke' and 'a number of days' from the copy. Recommendation: (a) now: withdrawing consent should be a user right. Duration later, from fixed choices (7, 14, 30), or drop it from the copy. Ship with rls-check cases and a separate security review.

REPORT SELF-REPLACE. Options: (a) users may replace their report (audited unlink + ingest, no second +100, rate-limited); (b) super admin only, and the 'Upload' copy says 'Add your report'. Recommendation: (a) for self-uploaded reports, (b) for admin-linked ones. Derive the copy from method: 'uploaded by you', 'matched automatically', 'linked by an administrator'. Never show 'linked by your admin'.

WEEKLY INSIGHT. Options for Snooze: hide until Monday vs collapse to a one-line 'Snoozed until Monday · Show'. Options for personalisation: keep the global 6-item rotation (and fix the copy 'chosen for crews like yours') vs select by the user's notification_focus. Recommendation: collapse rather than hide, and stay confirmable from /app/insights. Fix the copy now. Add super-admin authoring of weekly_insights later, so the archive is not 6 repeating items.

REWARDS ON THE CANVAS. Options: no in-widget Redeem (link to the catalog only) vs in-widget Redeem with the existing confirm. Selection rule: cheapest affordable first, then nearest unaffordable. Recommendation: in-widget Redeem with the 'Redeem {title}?' / 'Balance after' confirm, plus revalidatePath('/app'). Show '{n} left · {cost − balance} more credits needed' only when the reward is unaffordable.

ADD A 'LATEST BRIEFING' WIDGET AND AN 'INCOMING REQUESTS' SURFACE. Options: add them now, add them to the library later, or never. Recommendation: add 'Latest briefing' (L/XL, the card titles of the newest session with 'Copy all cards →') to the library in the personalisation phase, and add inline review to Partners in v1. Both close gaps the concept leaves in the product's main loop.

LIVE GUIDE POLICY. Options for opening: auto-open for every user at release, auto-open for new users only with a dismissible pill for existing users, or manual only. Step list: the fixed 12 vs generated from role and visible widgets. Recommendation: new users only, never re-open after 'Skip', and generate steps (renumbering the dots). Teach move/resize only once those features exist. Make the guide a non-modal dialog with Escape = Skip when it has focus. Store progress in user_guide_progress. Admin guides come later.

KEYBOARD MODEL. Options: buttons only (as the board) vs full: Escape deselect, aria-pressed on title bars, a roving-tabindex toolbar, a keyboard 'Move' mode, and Cmd/Ctrl+K search. Recommendation: full. Set Escape precedence to open Modal/Drawer, then guide card, then widget selection. Keep the title in an h2 with the select button separate from the grip.

ROLE GATING ON THE CREW CANVAS. Options: the same widgets for every role vs registry-gated. Recommendation: gate in the registry. Partners, Request, Review and Revoke are end_user only. Rewards needs an organization. 'Org admin' and 'Console' links follow the current switchLinks rules. A super admin opening /admin needs an org picker or the link hidden.

ORG ADMIN PER-PERSON ACTIONS. Options: allow 'Remind' on 'Missing reports' and 'Sharing requests'; allow only on missing reports; allow neither. Recommendation: never on 'Sharing requests' (consent coercion). Allow on 'Missing reports' only after a notification channel exists, honouring quiet hours and rate limits. Scope the 'Anonymity wall' text to the Dashboard page.

ORG ADMIN ACCOUNT CREATION. Options: invite by email (needs SMTP and an invitations table) vs keep temporary passwords; whether org admins may create org admins. Recommendation: keep temporary passwords with a copy-once link fallback until SMTP exists, and give org admins a crew-only role option. Include 'Full name'.

WEEKLY ACTIVITY TOTAL. Options: include manager coaching in 'Total' (board) vs exclude it (current code). Recommendation: exclude it from 'Total' and the training-needs signal, and optionally show a visually separated 'Coaching' column.

EXPORTS AND SMALL-CELL PRIVACY. Options: everything the boards list vs a whitelist. Recommendation: allow aggregate CSVs and members/audit CSVs with critical audit and a formula-injection guard. Never export mappings, the identity log or reflection or coaching text. Suppress any aggregate or research slice with n < 5.

TIER AND RULES DATA. Options: adopt the super board's sample values (synergy_brief 40/day/3, thresholds 0/150/500/1,200) vs keep the seed (25/day/2, 0/100/300/600). Recommendation: keep the seed; values are editable data in /super/rules. Drop 'Add rule' and 'Add tier', which the code cannot support. Keep all 6 real rules, including report_verified and streak_bonus.

SEARCH. Options: none in v1; a navigation palette (pages, widgets, commands); or data search over own sessions, partners, rewards and insights. Recommendation: a v1 palette over navigation plus the user's own sessions. Never search people beyond the partner picker, and never search wall data.

ORG DEFAULT LAYOUTS AND TELEMETRY. Options: let org admins set the crew default layout, and/or collect widget-usage stats. Recommendation: neither in v1. If telemetry is ever added, expose it only as aggregates with k ≥ 5.

RTL/HEBREW. Options: out of scope vs planned. Recommendation: decide now. Either way build with logical properties (inline-start/end) so the left bar, guide candidates and arrow keys can mirror later without a rewrite.

ROLLOUT. Options: big-bang replace of /app vs a feature flag per org with the old Overview kept for one release. Recommendation: flag per org, with default layout_version 1 and a 'Back to classic overview' escape hatch during pilot. Apply migrations to the Netlify demo and the share-tunnel environment before enabling.
recommended_phasing: PHASE 0: DECIDE AND CONSOLIDATE (no UI). Owner settles the decisions above, especially: scope, customisation level, full-view model, main-bar behaviour, brand, palette/danger split, tier names, mode label, coaching and consent lifecycle. Merge the five spec variants into one naming set: user_canvas_layouts(user_id, surface, page), user_guide_progress, one admin_wall_report_meta(), one consent extension, one route map (history, briefing form, ledger, insights, search) and one helper set. Fix copy that is wrong in the current app and in the guide: 'coaching routine', 'orange dot', 'chosen for crews like yours', '+20' once per day, 'linked by your admin'. Read node_modules/next/dist/docs as AGENTS.md requires. Exit: a signed-off decision log and a single spec.

PHASE 1: FOUNDATIONS. src/app/globals.css: hue-275 tokens, navy ink, a --brand red separate from --bad, the existing amber warn kept, the dot grid, the toolbar unit, and dark values for all of them. src/components/icons.tsx: the concept icon set. src/components/ui.tsx: a WidgetFrame primitive (h2 title, a separate select button with aria-pressed, a grip, a meta slot, a 2px selection ring, a footnote slot) plus KPI, list, table and bar-list bodies. src/lib/utils.ts helpers with Vitest tests: shortName, relativeDay (user time zone), sessionTitle, ROUTINE_SHORT, effectiveStreak. Data fixes: select scenario_context on the home page, revalidatePath('/app') in redeemReward and createConsentRequest, filter coaching out of crew Recent, use the effective streak. One migration with my_credit_summary(), my_sharing_partners() and the service-role admin_wall_report_meta(), using the explicit revoke/grant lockdown, then npm run db:types and new cases in scripts/rls-check.mjs. Exit: tests green and no visible change yet.

PHASE 2: CREW CANVAS v1, FIXED LAYOUT, BEHIND A PER-ORG FLAG. CrewShell gets the sticky bottom main bar on every /app/* page and the sticky left context bar on /app only. The selection model includes Escape, click-outside, aria-live and a roving-tabindex toolbar. Seven widgets ship at M size with every state designed: first run, report missing/blocked, empty, confirmed, out of stock, incoming request with inline 'Approve · +15' / 'Decline'. Left-bar tools wire only to existing routes and actions; tools without a backend are hidden, not inert. Pin, Resize, Arrange and Lock stay off. Phone uses the phone-board pattern: header row, a single column with bottom insets, floating bar plus sheet, and a 'More' sheet holding 'My report', 'Notifications & privacy', 'Appearance', switch links and 'Sign out'. Toasts move above the bars. Exit: crew can do everything they can today from the canvas, on desktop, tablet and phone, in light and dark.

PHASE 3: FULL VIEWS (the 'other pages'). Build the detail-page template first, then restyle: briefing form (with ?routine=&partner=&from= prefill and a context drawer), session detail with action cards and #reflection, full History with filters and pagination, Sharing restructured into 'To review', 'Sharing with me', 'My requests', 'I share with', Report with Privacy and a method-based linked line, Rewards with #catalog, #redeemed and #rules, a tier ladder and the new ledger, the new /app/insights archive, and Settings. Exit: every left-bar tool and main-bar button lands on a designed page or drawer.

PHASE 4: PERSONALISATION. user_canvas_layouts table and saveCanvasLayout (Zod-validated against a widget registry, optimistic concurrency, debounced). Then Hide, Add (library drawer, including the new 'Latest briefing' widget), Reset (with confirm) and Lock. Then S/M/L/XL through a radiogroup picker, with per-widget density driven by container queries so a resize needs no refetch; author the missing S/L/XL content for Insight, Partners, Report and Rewards first. Then keyboard Move mode, and only after that pointer drag with a bundled library and the free-slot placeholder. Pin and Arrange come last. Phone gets hide plus Move up/Move down. Insight Snooze (collapsed state) uses the same table. Exit: WCAG 2.5.7 and 2.1.1 pass in an e2e suite (add Playwright).

PHASE 5: LIVE GUIDE. user_guide_progress plus saveGuideProgress. A GuideProvider mounted in CrewShell so the tour survives navigation, with a 'Guide paused · Resume' pill. Port place() to a pure tested function, with an SVG-mask spotlight slotted into the app's z-scale below Modal/Drawer. Steps are generated from role, visible widgets and feature flags, and step 12 lights the main bar. Phone gets a bottom-docked card. Add the /app/guide text version and 'Restart guide' in Settings. Auto-open for new users only. Exit: a keyboard and screen-reader walkthrough passes, and the step count adapts.

PHASE 6: CONSENT AND REPORT SEMANTICS (separate security review). Consent 'revoked' and 'cancelled' statuses, a rewritten private.consent_guard, requester and target update policies, and revokeConsent / cancelConsentRequest with audit. Requested duration only if approved. Report self-replace through one audited wall transaction, with no re-award. Update STATUS_TONE, the org_engagement_stats consumers and docs/ARCHITECTURE.md, and extend rls-check with: a requester cannot approve or revoke, a target cannot cancel, nobody can resurrect a consent. Exit: the security review is signed off before the 'Revoke' and 'Upload'/replace tools turn on.

PHASE 7: ORG ADMIN CONSOLE (only if decision 1 includes it). Fix the main-bar tab sizing (the board's .mainbar>button.main rule overlaps the text tabs). Add aggregate RPCs with a weeks parameter, zero-filled weeks, effective consent status and k ≥ 5 suppression. Add CSV exports with critical audit and a formula-injection guard. Build canvases for 'Dashboard', 'Users & crews', 'Report ingestion', 'Feedback coaching' and 'Rewards', with forms kept as inline widgets that do not participate in drag. Teams, invitations and reminders ship only after their decisions and infrastructure (SMTP) exist. Coaching output moves to /admin/coaching/[id]. Exit: no per-person consent data and no unsuppressed small cells reach org admins.

PHASE 8: SUPER ADMIN CONSOLE. Add admin_wall_unlinked_count() and paged wall list functions (org name, cross-org auto-match, defer/'Skip'). Add a /api/super/health endpoint that never calls the model, plus /super/audit, /super/usage, /super/users and /super/organizations/[id], and prompt diff/rollback. Keep every existing confirm dialog. Drop the exports on 'Active mappings' and 'Identity audit log'. Keep the real rule and family vocabulary. Exit: the wall data never leaves /super, and the badge counts no longer fetch candidate hints.

PHASE 9: POLISH AND REACH. Search palette (Cmd/Ctrl+K), admin guides, org default layouts and telemetry only if approved, RTL if chosen, Realtime or focus-refetch for badges, and a visual-regression suite across the 12/6/1-column, phone and dark variants. Remove the old Overview and the flag. Redeploy the Netlify demo and the share tunnel with the migrations applied, update README/ARCHITECTURE/SECURITY, and record the new tables in the data-access matrix.
